prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact happened. My shoulder hit the door frame and I felt sharp pain almost immediately, and I have been treated for a shoulder injury since then. I have described the events the same way each time I have spoken with the adjuster, the police officer at the scene, and my medical providers, and I am glad to repeat it again. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so that my claim can be processed. I have kept copies of the repair estimate and the medical notes and can provide them on request.
